newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to privatize $1 billion by 1997 - Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: Israel to privatize $1 billion by 1997 - Netanyahu.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday he expected Israel would privatize at least $1 billion worth of assets by the end of 1997.

"I think you're going to see privatization of at least four billion shekels, that's over one billion dollars, worth of assets in the coming year. That's our minimal programme," Netanyahu told the Cable News Network (CNN).
Netanyahu, who promised a sweeping selloff of state-owned enterprises upon taking power last June, said legal barriers, not unions, were the main obstacles to the sale of state assets.
"We need to take the time to prepare the legal briefs that will enable you to push the privatization through so it's not stopped in the courts," he told the television.
The Israeli government is expected to announce a wide-ranging privatisation programme later this month.

"The best thing we can do to make the stock market in Israel healthy is to enlarge the pond. To make our stock market rise is to make stock available on the market, and therefore we really need to perform the privatization," Netanyahu said.
